method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Commonwealth of Australia Constitution Act (The Constitution), Compilation No. 6, compilation date 29 July 1977, includes amendments up to Act No. 84, 1977, register id C2013Q00005 (registered 18 November 2021), deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004Q00685.txt

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: covering clause 9, the Constitution: s 44(i)-(v) and the proviso to (iv) (disqualification; foreign citizenship ended only by a renunciation effective under foreign law, an input; the reasonable-steps gloss not encoded); ss 16, 34 (qualifications, with the Parliament's replacement under 'until the Parliament otherwise provides' asked as a fact); s 43 (member of one House ineligible for the other); s 45 (vacancy once chosen); s 46 (100 pounds a day, as written)
seat: the would-be candidate (a person who wants to be chosen as a senator or member of the House of Representatives)
